identity.name: Prakash Adhikari
identity.positioning: AI products, SaaS platforms, automation systems, and digital tools — built from idea to working product.
identity.philosophy: I am interested in problems messy enough to require more than a template. The interesting part is not the idea — it is making the system actually work.

systems.name: NepalIPMS
systems.purpose: The operating system for an IP law practice.

story.problem: IP firms tracked renewals in spreadsheets, files scattered across drives, and Department of Industry status in memory — until a client called.
story.system: I modeled the desk itself: company → file → matter → asset. Deadline engines, register search, litigation, and documents in one platform — 300+ API endpoints and 150+ migrations on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2.
story.intelligence: A 130K+ record trademark register made searchable during live client calls, with OCR bulletin intake wired directly into matter creation.
story.outcome: 130K+ trademark records managed and used daily by IP firms, including Global Law Associates.

systems.name: AI OCR Engine
systems.purpose: Legal bulletins turned into structured, reviewable data.

story.problem: Government trademark bulletins arrived as dense bilingual PDFs, and staff re-typed rows by hand during filing season.
story.system: A staged pipeline: upload → R2 → layout OCR → classification → AI extraction → review queue → register search and reminders. Extraction is separated from intelligence so nothing merges blindly.
story.intelligence: AI extraction proposes fields; a human confirms confidence before anything becomes a matter. Acceleration with expert control intact.
story.outcome: Moved from prototype to production intake running inside NepalIPMS.

systems.name: Global Law
systems.purpose: A knowledge platform for a practicing IP firm.

story.problem: A serious IP and corporate practice needed a credible digital presence and a place to publish legal knowledge — not a brochure site.
story.system: Content architecture first: practice areas, a knowledge center, and 100+ SEO-ready pages the firm can maintain on its own.
story.intelligence: Structured publishing workflows and an SEO surface designed for discovery and long-term maintenance.
story.outcome: Live at globallaw.com.np; the same firm runs its daily IP operations on NepalIPMS.

systems.name: ScholarQuest
systems.purpose: The full study-abroad journey in one platform.

story.problem: Study-abroad guidance was fragmented across destinations, test prep, and counsellors.
story.system: A single platform for destination guidance, test preparation, and counsellor-ready lead intake across the entire student journey.
story.intelligence: A content and conversion architecture that routes students from discovery to a structured inquiry.

story.problem: Nepal public-service exam preparation lacked structured, mobile-first digital tools.
story.system: A bilingual (Nepali / English) learning shell with mobile-first study navigation for PSC aspirants.
story.intelligence: A learning UX designed around how aspirants actually study on their phones.
story.outcome: Live production platform for PSC aspirants.

systems.name: Hire an Expert
systems.purpose: Trust-first matching between clients and verified experts.

story.problem: Expert discovery is opaque, and quality is hard to verify before you commit.
story.system: A marketplace architecture built around verification: structured brief → match → engagement, with admin onboarding and quality-control paths.
story.intelligence: A trust model that treats verification and matching as the core product, not an afterthought.
story.outcome: Designed as a full system architecture — documented as a case study rather than a live product.

process.title: RESEARCH
process.body: Sit with the real desk, files, and failure modes. Map who decides, who operates, and what "done" actually looks like before a line of code exists.

process.title: PRODUCT DESIGN
process.body: Shape the path people repeat every day so the product disappears into the workflow instead of adding one more thing to manage.

process.title: ARCHITECTURE
process.body: Model data, boundaries, and failure recovery — domain models shaped like the real world, from company to file to matter to asset.

process.title: DEVELOPMENT
process.body: APIs, persistence, auth, and operational safety. 300+ endpoints and 150+ migrations built to hold up under real firm load.

process.title: INTELLIGENCE
process.body: Add extraction, retrieval, or automation only where it genuinely reduces work — always with a human confidence review before anything commits.

process.title: DEPLOYMENT
process.body: Edge-native release on Cloudflare, then watch production use closely and tighten the parts that actually matter.
